text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday. I got you those nail<n>wraps you said
you wanted.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, I've been dying to try<n>these! Literally
gagged! Anything City<n>picks out is sure to be
straight up<n>gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I picked out some designs I<n>think you'd like.
Also, is it just me, or<n>have nail wraps really
stepped up<n>their game lately?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! They're like, so easy to<n>apply! And you can
layer 'em, too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, not having to scrape them<n>off like gel
nails is a lifesaver! My<n>nails are thanking me for
real.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right, they're a breeze to get off. Gel<n>nails are such
a pain when you have<n>a photoshoot...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Didn't you say before that<n>you don't
really do your nails outside<n>of work?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know, let's try on some of those<n>wraps you just
gave me! Here, I'll<n>help you put 'em on!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um, sure, I guess... These were<n>supposed to be for
you, though...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well they're mine now, no? So like, I<n>can use them
how I want, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha... You win, girl. Go ahead.
